thread:
chris-ml: Quick RFC follow-up: experimenting with quantile-based routing instead of hard buckets. thought is route by p90/p95 latency targets, then grow/shrink bins dynamically.

tara-platform: hmm can you sketch how bins are resized? live autoscale or periodic rebin?

chris-ml: start periodic (1m) + hysteresis. algorithm: if bin q95 > target * 1.15 then split; if q90 < target * 0.8 and shard count>1 then merge. want to avoid oscillation.

alana-arch: splitting on q95 could be noisy for low-traffic tenants. suggest min-reqs per-bin (e.g., 100 reqs) and use Bayesian smoothing for early estimates.

miguel-sre: also need to consider cache warmup: when we split, new shard gets cold KV cache -> temporary latency spike. how do we account for cold-start penalty in decision?

chris-ml: good call. proposal: simulate a synthetic penalty amortized into the bin's q95 score for X minutes post-split (configurable). we can also prefer splits to siblings that share warmed cache (model-version affinity).

sara-pm: important: product wants predictable p95 for premium tenants. can we pin certain tenants to non-shrinking bins or give them an SLA weight so routing never demotes them?

alana-arch: yes — add tenant affinity flags and an "immovable" tag. routing engine should treat those shards as minimum capacity reserved and exclude them from merge candidates.

miguel-sre: ops concerns: state explosion if every tenant pins. limit to top N by revenue or allow request-based admission. also need an emergency rollback hook.

chris-ml: rollout plan: feature flag gating + metric guardrails (p95, error-rate, cost delta). default OFF for hosted, enable for internal-only first week. rollback via FF off.

tara-platform: how will this interact with multi-region? If a bin is split in us-east, should the sibling be created in eu-west to handle geo preference? sounds like complexity.

alana-arch: keep region routing orthogonal: bins are per-region by default. cross-region sibling creation only for tenants with explicit geo-fanout. avoid global splits unless requested.

miguel-sre: logs and observability: need new tags: bin_id, parent_bin, split_reason, synthetic_penalty_applied. also count of warm-keys transferred.

dev-bot: deploy queued for canary: service/routing-engine:v2-beta -> canary hosts (2). CI checks: unit + perf smoke.

sara-pm: UX: add console flag to mark tenant immovable, plus a small explainer: "immovable tenants reserve baseline capacity; extra cost may apply".

chris-ml: action items: (1) chris to draft config schema for bin-resize + penalties, (2) alana to validate smoothing priors, (3) miguel to add observability tags and rollback playbook, (4) tara to add FF gate and rollout checklist.

tara-platform: noted. I'll create the FF and a canary plan. aim to start internal canary next week.

alana-arch: will prototype Bayesian smoothing this afternoon and post numbers.

miguel-sre: will schedule a short oncall drill for rollback next Wed.

chris-ml: nice. thanks all. will post RFC addendum with the config and pseudocode (including the simulated cold-penalty formula) shortly.

sara-pm: thanks — once RFC addendum is up, i'll mark product review accepted pending canary outcomes. :thumbsup
